links.outcome: Run-to-run reproducibility of DISCERN scores across 10 repeated runs
links.effect: Substantial run-to-run variability, mean score range of 17.5 points and ranges up to 43 points for the same webpage; averaging across runs did not improve agreement.
links.quote: Substantial run-to-run variability was observed with a mean score range of 17.5 points and ranges up to 43 points for the same webpage.

links.outcome: Agreement with human DISCERN scores across three GPT models and four prompting strategies
links.effect: Agreement was weak to moderate; o3 consistently outperformed GPT-5.2 and GPT-4o, and combined prompting modestly improved agreement and reduced absolute error.
links.quote: Combined prompting modestly improved agreement and reduced absolute error, particularly for the o3 model, which consistently outperformed GPT-5.2 and GPT-4o.

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT DISCERN scores against human-derived ground-truth scores
links.effect: Weak to moderate agreement with human scores; systematic score compression, overestimating low-quality and underestimating high-quality webpages.
links.quote: All models demonstrated systematic score compression, overestimating low-quality webpages and underestimating high-quality webpages.
